1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device __compares a sequence of the document actions with a sequence of the demonstrated user actions to identify correspondence between the sequences__.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __and determines whether the demonstrated user actions match the current step before identifying the current step__.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting includes visual indication of steps not yet performed__.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, __wherein the user interface further displays guidance information related to the current step__.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by predicting which step should follow based on the sequence of demonstrated user actions__.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting is performed in advance of the user performing the next step__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, __wherein the user interface provides predictive guidance for the next step__.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on __a comparison of action sequences rather than individual action types, comparing temporal ordering and dependencies between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions__.

9. (Original)

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the alignment device learns from patterns in the previous user experiences to improve future alignments__.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, __wherein the document action extractor identifies dependencies between the steps__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the alignment device compares sequences of actions rather than individual actions__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, __wherein the alignment device further comprises a sequence analyzer that determines correspondence between sequences of document actions and sequences of demonstrated user actions__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the alignment device uses statistical analysis of previous user experiences to weight the similarity metric__.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step includes comparing sequences of the document actions with sequences of the demonstrated user actions to identify correspondence between the sequences__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __wherein the identifying step includes verifying that the demonstrated user actions match the current step__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting includes visual indication of steps not yet performed__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __wherein the identifying step includes predicting which step should follow based on the sequence of demonstrated user actions__.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting is performed in advance of the user performing the next step__.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on __a comparison of action sequences rather than individual action types, comparing temporal ordering and dependencies between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions__.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the computing step uses statistical analysis of previous user experiences to weight the similarity metric__.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, __wherein the extracting step identifies dependencies between the steps__.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step includes comparing sequences of the document actions with sequences of the demonstrated user actions to identify correspondence between the sequences__; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, __wherein the computing step further comprises analyzing temporal relationships between the demonstrated user actions to determine alignment with the documented procedure__.

31.
